import { vModelText as _vModelText, withDirectives as _withDirectives, createElementVNode as _createElementVNode, openBlock as _openBlock, createElementBlock as _createElementBlock, Fragment as _Fragment, renderList as _renderList } from "vue"


export default {
  __name: 'Layout',
  setup(__props) {

const rows = { a: { k: { x: 1 } } };

return (_ctx, _cache) => {
  return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, [
    _createElementVNode("div", null, [...(_cache[0] || (_cache[0] = [
      _createElementVNode("div", null, [
        _createElementVNode("Child", { ":x": "1" }, "{{ x }}"),
        _createElementVNode("slot", { name: "s" }, "f")
      ], -1 /* CACHED */)
    ]))]),
    (_openBlock(true), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, _renderList(rows, (row, { k }) => {
      return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock("div", null, [
        _withDirectives(_createElementVNode("input", {
          "onUpdate:modelValue": $event => ((k.x) = $event)
        }, null, 8 /* PROPS */, ["onUpdate:modelValue"]), [
          [_vModelText, k.x]
        ])
      ]))
    }), 256 /* UNKEYED_FRAGMENT */))
  ], 64 /* STABLE_FRAGMENT */))
}
}

}
